purpose: Proposed instrument rows for the oracle-boundary measurement, mapped to existing GSPC axes only. No new axis is proposed. Nothing here is a run, a score, or a card.

axis_mapping.fit: Feed contract identity, chain pinning, freshness, and round-metadata completeness are deterministic on-chain facts, the same shape as ChainFacts issuer-control rows.

proposed_rows.fact: (chainId, proxyAddress, description()) readback agrees with the frozen issuer registry entry
decimals() readback matches the registry-declared decimals
latestRoundData().updatedAt within declared heartbeat + grace at read time
answeredInRound >= roundId and startedAt > 0 and updatedAt > 0
issuer registry row for (name, path) resolves to exactly one proxyAddress and it equals the read address

axis_mapping.fit: Only the boundary question: does oracle-published PoR data constitute independently checkable reserve evidence? Estate precedent (signed card de15a9f881955973, WBTC) answers: custodian-fed oracle values are not independently readable; INDEXED, no parity claimed.

proposed_rows.fact: PoR feed value is issuer/custodian-fed and not independently readable from the consumer path
proposed_rows.note: PASS means the boundary was correctly reported as UNCHECKABLE-for-reserves, not that reserves exist

axis_mapping.blocker: GAP-01: PoR documentation 404 at collection time; no PoR feed content frozen. Rows stay UNMEASURED until a frozen PoR source exists.

axes_considered_and_rejected.reason: No governing-regime evidence collected for Chainlink in this pack; do not stretch.
Reader-classification construct does not fit oracle reads.
No custodian/auditor naming evidence frozen (GAP-01 blocks the PoR path).
Declared slot about MCP declared-vs-executed scope; unrelated to oracle reads.

denominator_proposal.bank: chainlink-feed-bank.jsonl: every Ethereum-mainnet entry parseable from the frozen registry page (raw_sha256 9e2de906158f8e5014ff1662bd0b48d2e9b7fa324bacf081aaa9b28c8080e156), deduplicated by proxyAddress, testnet-marked entries excluded by rule.
denominator_proposal.minimum_n_basis: ADR-002 precedent: no MEASURED status below n >= 30 probed subjects. Bank n=253 satisfies the floor; all 253 rows must be attempted in any run.
denominator_proposal.completeness_rule: The denominator is the full parsed registry set at the frozen hash, not a sample; n reported = rows attempted, with unreachable feeds kept as UNCHECKABLE rows, never dropped.

grader_proposal.type: deterministic decoder + comparator, no model in the loop
inputs: pinned block readbacks (eth_chainId, description, decimals, latestRoundData per feed)
grader_proposal.smoke_test: chainlink-grader-smoke-eth-usd.json: all five control facts PASS on the frozen canary read; smoke output is a grader-execution proof, not a measurement run

run_output_proposal: Shape per public/interop/financial-measure-run-v2.json (csoai.financial-measure-run/0.2): per-feed control_facts with three-state verdicts, risk_verdict_status UNMEASURED, supersedes pointer on correction, UNREACHABLE never FAIL.
blocking_conditions_for_measured: Full-bank run exists but is UNSIGNED (chainlink-oracle-boundary-run-unsigned.json, run_attestation CONTENT_ADDRESSED_UNSIGNED); a candidate run is not a measurement
Second-seat replay (GAP-07 closed at endpoint level only; physical seat is shared)
PoR naming-mismatch policy: the 14 abbreviation-family identity FAILs need a pinned, pre-ruled normalisation rule or they stand as FAIL
Run output signed into the public root by the board signer (nothing local signs)
Signed card and run reconcile with the board slot
